integrity: The self-contained finite verifier reconstructs every face, all boundary ranks and all automorphism traces; assertions beyond these and standard group/chain theory are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology representation of this single graph only. The nonequivariant wedge-of-spheres result is prior work. No integral-torsion classification or general complete-bipartite theorem is claimed. Literature indexing may omit an equivalent character computation.
title: Complete rational automorphism character of the \(K_{3,3}\) Morse complex
